title: [task] characterization test for datedTickerPageFileName
body:
add a characterization test for datedTickerPageFileName in src/ticker-reference-dated.ts: page file names
- datedTickerPageFileName(1) is "page-001.rdust"
- datedTickerPageFileName(42) is "page-042.rdust"
- datedTickerPageFileName(1000) is "page-1000.rdust"
- datedTickerPageFileName(0) throws INVALID_DATED_TICKER_PAGE
